aliases: Internal model evaluation and use survey
Internal model use survey (drop-in entry-level researcher)
eval.description: Survey of Anthropic technical staff about whether a Claude model can automate entry-level researcher work in their domain, and how much it raises their productivity. Respondents use the model on real AI R&D tasks, then answer questions such as drop-in replacement for an L4 / junior researcher and estimated productivity uplift. Used as qualitative evidence for AI R&D ASL determinations. Lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures whether the model can do entry-level AI research work and how much it increases staff productivity.

versions.changes: Anthropic reports the instrument and thresholds still change. Early Claude 4 cards used a small researcher sample; later cards widen sampling beyond power users.

scores.description: Respondent believes the model can fully automate (or become a drop-in replacement for) entry-level / junior researcher work in their domain under the card’s elicitation window.
Respondent’s estimated productivity uplift from using the model (reported as a percent in cards).

metrics.description: Share of surveyed staff who believe the model can automate entry-level researcher work (cards also report raw counts such as 0/4 or 0/16).
Mean estimated productivity uplift across respondents (percent).
